verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm Logseq keeps local data as Markdown files that users sync with GitHub and that it is intended as an offline-first app (comm-7, comm-1, comm-19, comm-20). Full graph export to standard Markdown, JSON, OPML and EDN gives an app-independent copy (docs-30). However, the newer DB version moves away from plain Markdown files, which users say breaks editing pages outside the app (comm-14, comm-11), and the generated Markdown has compatibility quirks with other tools (comm-19). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of local file storage and full offline operation, a guarantee that data stays readable outside the app in the DB version, and clean interoperable Markdown.
